title: Design System: Malaybalay City Hall kiosk

extensions.scope: Shared public kiosk; admin and phone retain their layouts.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Separate the active modal from the inactive page.

responsiveModes: Actual viewport pixels without canvas scaling
Landscape: two columns from 960px when aspect ratio allows

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Start walking playback paused, with explicit Resume action.

kioskBackground.overlay: none; show the supplied image at its original visibility

components.name: Search field
components.html: <label class="ds-search">Find a service<input type="search" placeholder="Service, office or document"></label>

components.name: Service summary
components.html: Processing timeAs listed in the Citizen’s Charter

narrative.overview: The owner's references define the office and service detail composition. The subsequent deployment-readiness request extends one consistent visual system across the kiosk, with calmer typography and more space at laptop widths.
keyCharacteristics: Flat navy page bands and blue primary actions.
Readable information with responsive typography and space.
Fine borders, white surfaces and the supplied subdued pattern.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Display official service text and genuine location status; visual polish must not imply that an unverified route or location has been checked.

dos: Do preserve translations, larger text, scrolling and visible focus.
Do keep Charter content and location status accurate.
donts: Don't truncate requirements or process text to fit a card.
Don't invent office locations, routes or accessibility connections.
